verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a SaaS financial infrastructure platform like Unit, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents region selection or data residency controls. Bank-partner choice, Federal Reserve connectivity and the SOC 2/PCI certifications are adjacent topics and do not show that users can pick where their data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
